verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Azure maintains extensive reference documentation across many domains—CLI (azure-docs-1/2/3), REST API (azure-docs-4/5/23), IaC tools like Bicep/ARM/Terraform (azure-docs-6/7/8/21), RBAC (azure-docs-10/11), and Cost Management APIs (azure-docs-14/22/30)—all hosted consistently on learn.microsoft.com, suggesting a shared docs infrastructure spanning many services, not just flagship ones. However, there's no direct evidence comparing doc depth/consistency for lesser-used or niche services versus flagship ones, and community threads focus on portal UX, pricing, and support rather than confirming reference-doc parity across services. Missing for 10: explicit coverage/consistency data for non-flagship or niche services, and independent developer commentary specifically praising or criticizing docs consistency (rather than UI/pricing/support).
